stage: Exploratory assumption audit, written before the new fits; existing outcomes have been examined in earlier analyses
purpose: Test whether the human application survives removal of stable respondent-specific alternative intercepts, and check a necessary common-participation restriction
population: 300 ordinary-source human-recruitment records under the canonical source definition; 60 AI pretests used only for an exact invariance control
models: Classical conditional multinomial logit with individual-specific alternative intercepts removed by conditioning on each person's A/B/outside counts; shared linear fee and G1/G2 slopes
The same conditional model with the seven free observed fee-rule cell utilities relative to G1 at CNY89
primary_contrast: G2 minus G1 at CNY89 under free observed cells, conditional on the shared-slope logit model
diagnostics: Exact enumeration of all3^8 sequences and count strata; analytic gradient and Hessian checks
Rank of within-count sufficient-feature variation; estimability of the CNY89 contrast
Exact objective and score invariance when adding the60 original constant AI vectors
56 one-sided Fisher tests for negative participation association:28 task pairs within each version; Holm family correction across all56
association_null: Each pair's odds ratio is at least1, a necessary consequence of conditional independence and a common monotone stable participation trait. Pairwise satisfaction is not sufficient to establish the full latent model.
inference: Record-level sandwich intervals for the fixed slope models, conditional on the original design and shared slopes; exploratory reused data, no confirmatory or model-selection-adjusted claim
target_limits: Conditioning discards participation and A/B count information. No unconditional outside shares, respondent intercepts, population prediction or general random-taste recovery is claimed.
originality_gate: These are established conditional-likelihood and association tools, not a new theory. A potential contribution needs a substantive unresolved choice-research question and an identifiable, robust empirical finding beyond using the tools.
stopping_rule: Retain both fixed models, every pairwise test and nonidentification/numerical failure. Do not add specifications or discard records to obtain significance.
